# Generador de Timelapse Sentinel-2 (Copernicus)

Esta herramienta te permite crear **timelapses de imágenes de satélite Sentinel-2** directamente desde tu navegador usando la API del [Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/). Puedes seleccionar cualquier área del mundo y generar una animación que muestra los cambios en la superficie terrestre desde 2017 hasta la actualidad, con una resolución de **10 metros**.

::: {.callout-note}
## Cómo usar esta herramienta

1. Regístrate en [Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/) si no lo has hecho
2. Crea un **OAuth Client** en el [Dashboard de Sentinel Hub](https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/#/account/settings) → sección "OAuth clients"
3. **¡Importante!** Al crear el client, marca la opción **"SPA (Single Page Application)"** y selecciona **"Allow all domains"**
4. Copia tu **Client ID** y **Client Secret** y pégalos en el panel
5. Haz clic en **Conectar con Copernicus** para obtener el token de acceso
5. Dibuja un **rectángulo** o **polígono** en el mapa para seleccionar el área
6. Configura las opciones (combinación de bandas, resolución, rango de años)
7. Haz clic en **Crear Timelapse** y espera a que se generen los fotogramas
8. Descarga el resultado como GIF animado o vídeo
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// ============================================
// GLOBALS
// ============================================
var map, drawnItems, drawControl, currentGeoJSON = null;
var frameOverlay = null, gifBounds = null;
var frames = [], frameIdx = 0, frameTimer = null;
var frameSpeed = 200, isPlaying = false, stopRequested = false;
var cdseToken = null, cdseTokenExpiry = 0;
var cdseClientId = '', cdseClientSecret = '';

// ============================================
// EVALSCRIPTS
// ============================================
var EVALSCRIPTS = {
    'TRUE_COLOR': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B04","B03","B02"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){return[2.5*s.B04,2.5*s.B03,2.5*s.B02]}',

    'FALSE_COLOR': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B08","B04","B03"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){return[2.5*s.B08,2.5*s.B04,2.5*s.B03]}',

    'SWIR': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B12","B8A","B04"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){return[3.5*s.B12,3.5*s.B8A,3.5*s.B04]}',

    'AGRICULTURE': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B11","B08","B02"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){return[2.5*s.B11,2.5*s.B08,2.5*s.B02]}',

    'GEOLOGY': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B12","B11","B02"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){return[3.5*s.B12,3.5*s.B11,3.5*s.B02]}',

    'NDVI': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B04","B08"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){var ndvi=(s.B08-s.B04)/(s.B08+s.B04);var r,g,b;if(ndvi<-0.2){r=0.05;g=0.05;b=0.05}else if(ndvi<0){r=0.75;g=0.75;b=0.75}else if(ndvi<0.1){r=0.86;g=0.86;b=0.86}else if(ndvi<0.2){r=0.92;g=0.73;b=0.2}else if(ndvi<0.3){r=0.69;g=0.76;b=0.38}else if(ndvi<0.4){r=0.57;g=0.75;b=0.32}else if(ndvi<0.5){r=0.44;g=0.64;b=0.25}else if(ndvi<0.6){r=0.31;g=0.54;b=0.18}else if(ndvi<0.7){r=0.19;g=0.43;b=0.11}else{r=0;g=0.27;b=0}return[r,g,b]}',

    'NDWI': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B03","B08"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){var ndwi=(s.B03-s.B08)/(s.B03+s.B08);var r,g,b;if(ndwi<-0.3){r=0.8;g=0.6;b=0.4}else if(ndwi<0){r=0.9;g=0.9;b=0.7}else if(ndwi<0.2){r=0.6;g=0.85;b=0.9}else if(ndwi<0.4){r=0.3;g=0.65;b=0.9}else{r=0.1;g=0.3;b=0.8}return[r,g,b]}',

    'NBR': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B08","B12"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){var nbr=(s.B08-s.B12)/(s.B08+s.B12);var r,g,b;if(nbr<-0.2){r=0.84;g=0.18;b=0.15}else if(nbr<0){r=0.99;g=0.55;b=0.35}else if(nbr<0.1){r=1;g=0.88;b=0.55}else if(nbr<0.27){r=0.85;g=0.94;b=0.6}else if(nbr<0.44){r=0.57;g=0.81;b=0.38}else{r=0.1;g=0.6;b=0.1}return[r,g,b]}',

    'NDBI': '//VERSION=3\nfunction setup(){return{input:["B11","B08"],output:{bands:3,sampleType:"AUTO"}}}\nfunction evaluatePixel(s){var ndbi=(s.B11-s.B08)/(s.B11+s.B08);var r,g,b;if(ndbi<-0.2){r=0.1;g=0.6;b=0.1}else if(ndbi<0){r=0.57;g=0.81;b=0.38}else if(ndbi<0.1){r=1;g=0.88;b=0.55}else if(ndbi<0.2){r=0.99;g=0.55;b=0.35}else{r=0.84;g=0.18;b=0.15}return[r,g,b]}'
};

// ============================================
// MAP SETUP
// ============================================
map = L.map('tl-map').setView([40.65, 0.6], 8);

var esriImagery = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
    attribution: 'Esri', maxZoom: 18
});
var osm = L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap', maxZoom: 19
});
var cartoLight = L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
    attribution: '&copy; CARTO', maxZoom: 20
});
var cartoDark = L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
    attribution: '&copy; CARTO', maxZoom: 20
});
var esriTopo = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Topo_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
    attribution: 'Esri', maxZoom: 18
});
esriImagery.addTo(map);

L.control.layers({
    'Esri Satélite': esriImagery, 'OpenStreetMap': osm,
    'Carto Claro': cartoLight, 'Carto Oscuro': cartoDark, 'Esri Topográfico': esriTopo
}, null, {position: 'bottomright'}).addTo(map);

// Search control
var SearchControl = L.Control.extend({
    options: { position: 'topleft' },
    onAdd: function(m) {
        this._container = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-search-control');
        this._container.style.cssText = 'background:white;padding:4px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);margin-left:50px;margin-top:-52px;';
        this._container.innerHTML = 
            '<input id="tl-search" type="text" placeholder="🔍 Buscar..." style="width:200px;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:3px;font-size:13px;">' +
            '<div id="tl-search-results" class="tl-search-results" style="position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:white;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;z-index:2000;display:none;max-width:200px;"></div>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(this._container);
        return this._container;
    }
});
map.addControl(new SearchControl());

// Scale bar
var ScaleBar = L.Control.extend({
    options: { position: 'bottomleft', numSegments: 4 },
    onAdd: function(m) {
        this._container = L.DomUtil.create('div');
        this._container.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);padding:8px 12px 6px 12px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(this._container);
        m.on('zoomend moveend resize', this._update, this);
        this._update();
        return this._container;
    },
    onRemove: function(m) { m.off('zoomend moveend resize', this._update, this); },
    _update: function() {
        var m=this._map, tPx=Math.round(m.getSize().x*0.2), y=m.getSize().y/2;
        var p1=m.containerPointToLatLng([0,y]), p2=m.containerPointToLatLng([tPx,y]);
        var dist=m.distance(p1,p2);
        var nice=[1,2,5,10,20,25,50,100,200,250,500,1000,2000,2500,5000,10000,20000,50000,100000,200000,500000];
        var n=this.options.numSegments, totalDist=0;
        for(var i=0;i<nice.length;i++){if(nice[i]*n<=dist)totalDist=nice[i]*n;}
        if(!totalDist)totalDist=dist;
        var segDist=totalDist/n, barPx=Math.round(tPx*totalDist/dist), segPx=barPx/n;
        var useKm=totalDist>=1000, unit=useKm?'km':'m', bH=8, tH=6, svgW=barPx+2, svgH=bH+tH+22;
        var svg='<svg width="'+svgW+'" height="'+svgH+'" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">';
        for(var s=0;s<n;s++){var x=1+s*segPx;svg+='<rect x="'+x+'" y="0" width="'+segPx+'" height="'+bH+'" fill="'+(s%2===0?'#000':'#fff')+'" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>';}
        for(var s=0;s<=n;s++){var x=1+s*segPx;svg+='<line x1="'+x+'" y1="'+bH+'" x2="'+x+'" y2="'+(bH+tH)+'" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.2"/>';var d=segDist*s,val=useKm?(d/1000):d;val=Math.round(val*100)/100;var anchor='middle';if(s===0)anchor='start';if(s===n)anchor='end';svg+='<text x="'+x+'" y="'+(bH+tH+13)+'" text-anchor="'+anchor+'" font-size="12" font-family="Arial" font-weight="bold" fill="#000">'+val+'</text>';}
        svg+='<text x="'+(barPx/2+1)+'" y="'+(svgH-1)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-family="Arial" fill="#333">'+unit+'</text></svg>';
        this._container.innerHTML=svg;
    }
});
map.addControl(new ScaleBar());

// North arrow
var NorthArrow = L.Control.extend({
    options:{position:'topleft'},
    onAdd:function(){var d=L.DomUtil.create('div','tl-north-arrow');d.innerHTML='&#9650;<span>N</span>';d.title='Norte';return d;}
});
map.addControl(new NorthArrow());

// Drawing tools
drawnItems = new L.FeatureGroup();
map.addLayer(drawnItems);
drawControl = new L.Control.Draw({
    draw:{polygon:true,rectangle:true,circle:false,circlemarker:false,marker:false,polyline:false},
    edit:{featureGroup:drawnItems}
});
map.addControl(drawControl);

map.on(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, function(e) {
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    drawnItems.addLayer(e.layer);
    currentGeoJSON = e.layer.toGeoJSON().geometry;
    document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-coords').innerText = JSON.stringify(
        currentGeoJSON.coordinates[0].map(function(c){return [c[1].toFixed(4),c[0].toFixed(4)];})
    );
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ ¡Área seleccionada!';
});
map.on(L.Draw.Event.DELETED, function() {
    currentGeoJSON = null;
    document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-coords').innerText = '';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '';
});

// Search box
(function(){
    var input=document.getElementById('tl-search'), results=document.getElementById('tl-search-results'), timer=null;
    input.addEventListener('input',function(){
        clearTimeout(timer); var q=input.value.trim();
        if(q.length<3){results.style.display='none';return;}
        timer=setTimeout(function(){
            fetch('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&limit=5&q='+encodeURIComponent(q))
            .then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(data){
                results.innerHTML='';
                if(!data.length){results.style.display='none';return;}
                data.forEach(function(item){
                    var row=document.createElement('div');row.innerText=item.display_name;
                    row.addEventListener('click',function(){map.flyTo([parseFloat(item.lat),parseFloat(item.lon)],13);input.value=item.display_name;results.style.display='none';});
                    results.appendChild(row);
                });
                results.style.display='block';
            });
        },400);
    });
    input.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')results.style.display='none';});
    document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(!input.parentElement.contains(e.target))results.style.display='none';});
})();

// ============================================
// CDSE AUTHENTICATION (OAuth2 Client Credentials)
// ============================================
function authenticateCDSE() {
    var clientId = document.getElementById('tl-client-id').value.trim();
    var clientSecret = document.getElementById('tl-client-secret').value.trim();
    if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Introduce tu Client ID y Client Secret.';
        return;
    }

    var btn = document.getElementById('tl-auth-btn');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerText = '⏳ Conectando...';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '⏳ Obteniendo token de acceso...';

    cdseClientId = clientId;
    cdseClientSecret = clientSecret;

    fetchCDSEToken(function(success) {
        if (success) {
            document.getElementById('tl-client-secret').value = '';
            document.getElementById('tl-auth-section').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('tl-config-section').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ Conectado a Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem';
            console.log('[CDSE Timelapse] Successfully connected!');
        } else {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerText = '🔐 Conectar con Copernicus';
        }
    });
}

function fetchCDSEToken(callback) {
    var body = 'grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=' + encodeURIComponent(cdseClientId) + '&client_secret=' + encodeURIComponent(cdseClientSecret);

    fetch('https://identity.dataspace.copernicus.eu/auth/realms/CDSE/protocol/openid-connect/token', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
        body: body
    })
    .then(function(r) {
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
        return r.json();
    })
    .then(function(data) {
        cdseToken = data.access_token;
        cdseTokenExpiry = Date.now() + (data.expires_in - 60) * 1000; // refresh 60s before expiry
        console.log('[CDSE Timelapse] Token obtained, expires in', data.expires_in, 'seconds');
        callback(true);
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
        console.error('[CDSE Timelapse] Token error:', err);
        var msg = err.message || '';
        // Detect CORS / network errors (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
        if (err instanceof TypeError || msg.toLowerCase().indexOf('fetch') !== -1 || msg.toLowerCase().indexOf('network') !== -1) {
            document.getElementById('tl-status').innerHTML = '❌ <b>Error de conexión (CORS)</b>. Tu OAuth Client debe estar configurado como <b>SPA</b> con <b>"Allow all domains"</b>. ' +
                '<a href="https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/#/account/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#003399;">Abrir Dashboard →</a>';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ Error de autenticación: ' + msg + '. Verifica tus credenciales.';
        }
        callback(false);
    });
}

function ensureToken(callback) {
    if (cdseToken && Date.now() < cdseTokenExpiry) {
        callback(true);
        return;
    }
    console.log('[CDSE Timelapse] Token expired, refreshing...');
    fetchCDSEToken(callback);
}

// ============================================
// PROCESS API REQUEST
// ============================================
function fetchSentinel2Frame(bbox, fromDate, toDate, bandType, resolution, maxCloud, callback) {
    ensureToken(function(ok) {
        if (!ok) { callback(null); return; }

        var evalscript = EVALSCRIPTS[bandType];
        if (!evalscript) { callback(null); return; }

        var requestBody = {
            input: {
                bounds: {
                    properties: { crs: "http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/OGC/1.3/CRS84" },
                    bbox: bbox
                },
                data: [{
                    type: "sentinel-2-l2a",
                    dataFilter: {
                        timeRange: { from: fromDate, to: toDate },
                        maxCloudCoverage: maxCloud
                    }
                }]
            },
            output: {
                width: resolution,
                height: resolution,
                responses: [{ identifier: "default", format: { type: "image/png" } }]
            },
            evalscript: evalscript
        };

        fetch('https://sh.dataspace.copernicus.eu/api/v1/process', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + cdseToken,
                'Accept': 'image/png'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(requestBody)
        })
        .then(function(r) {
            if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
            return r.blob();
        })
        .then(function(blob) {
            var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            callback(url);
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            console.error('[CDSE Timelapse] Process API error:', err);
            callback(null);
        });
    });
}

// ============================================
// TIMELAPSE CREATION
// ============================================
function createTimelapse() {
    if (!cdseToken || !currentGeoJSON) return;
    stopRequested = false;

    var startYear = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-start-year').value);
    var endYear = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-end-year').value);
    var startMonth = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-start-month').value);
    var endMonth = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-end-month').value);
    var bandType = document.getElementById('tl-bands').value;
    var resolution = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-resolution').value);
    var maxCloud = parseInt(document.getElementById('tl-cloud').value);

    if (startYear < 2017) {
        startYear = 2017;
        document.getElementById('tl-start-year').value = 2017;
    }
    if (startYear > endYear) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ El año de inicio debe ser menor que el de fin.';
        return;
    }

    // Get bbox from drawn geometry
    var coords = currentGeoJSON.coordinates[0];
    var lats = coords.map(function(c){return c[1];});
    var lngs = coords.map(function(c){return c[0];});
    var bbox = [Math.min.apply(null,lngs), Math.min.apply(null,lats), Math.max.apply(null,lngs), Math.max.apply(null,lats)];
    gifBounds = [[Math.min.apply(null,lats),Math.min.apply(null,lngs)],[Math.max.apply(null,lats),Math.max.apply(null,lngs)]];

    document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-stop-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-progress-container').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '⏳ Generando fotogramas...';
    drawnItems.clearLayers();

    frames = [];
    var years = [];
    for (var y = startYear; y <= endYear; y++) years.push(y);
    var total = years.length;
    var monthAbbr = ['','Ene','Feb','Mar','Abr','May','Jun','Jul','Ago','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dic'];

    function processYear(index) {
        if (stopRequested || index >= total) {
            if (!stopRequested) finishTimelapse();
            return;
        }
        var year = years[index];
        var pct = Math.round(((index+1)/total)*100);
        document.getElementById('tl-progress-fill').style.width = pct+'%';
        document.getElementById('tl-progress-text').innerText = 'Año '+year+' ('+(index+1)+'/'+total+')';

        var endDay = new Date(year, endMonth, 0).getDate();
        var fromDate = year+'-'+String(startMonth).padStart(2,'0')+'-01T00:00:00Z';
        var toDate = year+'-'+String(endMonth).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(endDay).padStart(2,'0')+'T23:59:59Z';

        fetchSentinel2Frame(bbox, fromDate, toDate, bandType, resolution, maxCloud, function(imageUrl) {
            if (stopRequested) return;
            if (!imageUrl) {
                frames.push({year: year, url: null, canvas: null});
                processYear(index + 1);
                return;
            }

            var img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
            img.onload = function() {
                var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = img.width; canvas.height = img.height;
                var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

                // Add year label
                var label = monthAbbr[startMonth]+'-'+monthAbbr[endMonth]+' '+year;
                ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
                var tw = ctx.measureText(label).width;
                var tx = canvas.width-tw-10, ty = 20;
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(tx-4, ty-14, tw+8, 20);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                ctx.fillText(label, tx, ty);

                URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
                frames.push({year: year, url: canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), canvas: canvas});
                processYear(index + 1);
            };
            img.onerror = function() {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
                frames.push({year: year, url: null, canvas: null});
                processYear(index + 1);
            };
            img.src = imageUrl;
        });
    }
    processYear(0);
}

function finishTimelapse() {
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){return f.url!==null;});
    if (!valid.length) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '❌ No se generaron fotogramas válidos.';
        document.getElementById('tl-stop-btn').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('tl-progress-container').style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }

    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ '+valid.length+' fotogramas. Creando GIF...';
    document.getElementById('tl-stop-btn').style.display = 'none';

    updateScrubberRange();
    frameIdx = 0; showFrame(0); startPlayer();

    document.getElementById('tl-pause-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-new-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-playback-controls').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-progress-container').style.display = 'none';

    document.getElementById('tl-opacity').oninput = function() {
        if (frameOverlay) frameOverlay.setOpacity(this.value/100);
    };
    document.getElementById('tl-speed').oninput = function() {
        frameSpeed = parseInt(this.value);
        if (isPlaying) startPlayer();
    };

    try {
        fetch('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gif.js@0.2.0/dist/gif.worker.js')
        .then(function(r){ return r.blob(); })
        .then(function(blob){
            var workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            var gif = new GIF({workers:2, quality:10, workerScript:workerUrl});
            valid.forEach(function(f){ gif.addFrame(f.canvas, {delay:200}); });
            gif.on('finished', function(gifBlob) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(workerUrl);
                var url = URL.createObjectURL(gifBlob);
                var dlBtn = document.getElementById('tl-download-btn');
                dlBtn.href = url; dlBtn.download = 'sentinel2-timelapse.gif'; dlBtn.style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('tl-video-btn').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ ¡Timelapse listo! '+valid.length+' fotogramas.';
            });
            gif.render();
        }).catch(function(err){
            document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ Animación lista ('+valid.length+' fotogramas). GIF: '+err.message;
        });
    } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '✅ Animación lista ('+valid.length+' fotogramas). GIF: '+e.message;
    }
}

// ============================================
// VIDEO EXPORT (WebM)
// ============================================
function exportAsVideo() {
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){ return f.url !== null; });
    if (!valid.length) return;

    var btn = document.getElementById('tl-video-btn');
    btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = '⏳ Generando vídeo...';

    var firstCanvas = valid[0].canvas;
    var w = firstCanvas.width, h = firstCanvas.height;
    var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    var stream = canvas.captureStream(0);
    var mimeType = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/webm;codecs=vp9')
        ? 'video/webm;codecs=vp9'
        : 'video/webm';
    var recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mimeType, videoBitsPerSecond: 2500000 });
    var chunks = [];
    recorder.ondataavailable = function(e) { if (e.data.size > 0) chunks.push(e.data); };
    recorder.onstop = function() {
        var blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'video/webm' });
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url; a.download = 'sentinel2-timelapse.webm';
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
        btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = '🎥 Exportar vídeo';
    };

    recorder.start();
    var i = 0;
    function drawNext() {
        if (i >= valid.length) {
            setTimeout(function() { recorder.stop(); }, 300);
            return;
        }
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
        ctx.drawImage(valid[i].canvas, 0, 0, w, h);
        stream.getVideoTracks()[0].requestFrame();
        i++;
        setTimeout(drawNext, frameSpeed);
    }
    drawNext();
}

// ============================================
// MAP FRAME PLAYER
// ============================================
function showFrame(idx) {
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){return f.url!==null;});
    if (!valid.length || !gifBounds) return;
    var op = document.getElementById('tl-opacity').value/100;
    if (frameOverlay) map.removeLayer(frameOverlay);
    frameOverlay = L.imageOverlay(valid[idx].url, gifBounds, {opacity:op}).addTo(map);
    var scrubber = document.getElementById('tl-frame-scrubber');
    var label = document.getElementById('tl-frame-label');
    if (scrubber) scrubber.value = idx;
    if (label && valid[idx]) label.innerText = '📅 ' + valid[idx].year;
}
function updateScrubberRange() {
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){return f.url!==null;});
    var scrubber = document.getElementById('tl-frame-scrubber');
    if (scrubber) { scrubber.max = Math.max(0, valid.length - 1); scrubber.value = 0; }
}
function scrubFrame(val) {
    var idx = parseInt(val);
    stopPlayer();
    document.getElementById('tl-pause-btn').innerText = '▶ Reproducir';
    frameIdx = idx;
    showFrame(idx);
}
function startPlayer() {
    stopPlayer(); isPlaying = true;
    document.getElementById('tl-pause-btn').innerText = '⏸ Pausa';
    var valid = frames.filter(function(f){return f.url!==null;});
    frameTimer = setInterval(function(){
        frameIdx = (frameIdx+1)%valid.length; showFrame(frameIdx);
    }, frameSpeed);
}
function stopPlayer() { if(frameTimer){clearInterval(frameTimer);frameTimer=null;} isPlaying=false; }
function togglePlay() {
    if (isPlaying) { stopPlayer(); document.getElementById('tl-pause-btn').innerText='▶ Reproducir'; }
    else startPlayer();
}
function stopTimelapse() {
    stopRequested = true; stopPlayer();
    document.getElementById('tl-stop-btn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-create-btn').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('tl-progress-container').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '⏹ Detenido.';
}
function resetTimelapse() {
    stopPlayer(); stopRequested = true;
    if (frameOverlay) { map.removeLayer(frameOverlay); frameOverlay=null; }
    gifBounds=null; frames=[]; frameIdx=0; currentGeoJSON=null;
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    ['tl-create-btn','tl-stop-btn','tl-download-btn','tl-new-btn','tl-pause-btn','tl-playback-controls','tl-progress-container'].forEach(function(id){
        document.getElementById(id).style.display='none';
    });
    document.getElementById('tl-video-btn').style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('tl-status').innerText = '';
    document.getElementById('tl-coords').innerText = '';
    document.getElementById('tl-frame-label').innerText = '';
}
function clearAll() { resetTimelapse(); }
</script>
```

## Sobre los Timelapse Sentinel-2 (Copernicus)

Los **timelapses Sentinel-2** son animaciones creadas a partir de imágenes del programa [Copernicus](https://www.copernicus.eu/) de la Unión Europea, capturadas por los satélites Sentinel-2A y Sentinel-2B desde 2017. Con una resolución de **10 metros**, permiten visualizar cambios como:

- **Expansión urbana**: crecimiento de ciudades y áreas metropolitanas
- **Deforestación y reforestación**: cambios en la cobertura forestal
- **Cambios en cuerpos de agua**: evolución de lagos, ríos y embalses
- **Agricultura**: rotación de cultivos y cambios en el uso del suelo
- **Impacto del cambio climático**: retroceso de glaciares, desertificación

### Combinaciones de bandas disponibles

- **Color real (B04/B03/B02)**: Muestra la superficie tal como la veríamos con nuestros ojos
- **Falso color (B08/B04/B03)**: Resalta la vegetación en tonos rojos
- **SWIR (B12/B8A/B04)**: Útil para detectar incendios y suelos desnudos
- **Agricultura (B11/B08/B02)**: Optimizada para análisis agrícola
- **Geología (B12/B11/B02)**: Resalta diferencias geológicas

### Índices espectrales

- **NDVI**: Índice de Vegetación de Diferencia Normalizada
- **NDWI**: Índice de Agua de Diferencia Normalizada
- **NBR**: Índice de Área Quemada Normalizado
- **NDBI**: Índice de Edificación de Diferencia Normalizada

### Requisitos

- Una cuenta gratuita en el [Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/)
- Un OAuth Client creado en el [Dashboard de Sentinel Hub](https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/#/account/settings)
- Navegador moderno con JavaScript habilitado

### Diferencias con el generador basado en Google Earth Engine

| Característica | GEE (Landsat) | CDSE (Sentinel-2) |
|---|---|---|
| Resolución | 30m (Landsat) | **10m (Sentinel-2)** |
| Datos desde | 1984 | 2017 |
| Autenticación | Token GEE + Proyecto | OAuth Client ID/Secret |
| Proveedor | Google | Unión Europea (Copernicus) |
| Coste | Gratuito | Gratuito |
